verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA compliance as well as dedicated VPC deployment with full data isolation (unstructured-supp-1, unstructured-docs-15/28), which supports processing sensitive documents like contracts or medical records under regulated environments. However, no evidence explicitly describes a 'zero-retention' data handling policy (e.g., automatic deletion after processing, no logging/storage of uploaded content) — missing for 10: explicit zero-retention/data-deletion guarantees, third-party audit evidence, and confirmation that hosted (non-dedicated) tiers offer the same compliance posture.
